messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "especially lithium"
set: ["especially lithium", "especially NSAIDs", "especially mineral oil", "especially diuretic or water pill", "especially heart or blood pressure medication", "especially in large amounts or regularly", "especially if you take other drugs as well", "based on weight especially in children and teenagers", "especially if you are on a long course", "especially someone with history of drug abuse or addiction", "especially diuretic or water pill that may increase blood potassium", "especially when an agent with greater diuretic potential is desired", "this may happen especially at the beginning of your treatment", "this lack of control is especially true at a 100 mg dose", "do so especially if you also have fever, unusual tiredness, or dark urine", "talk with your doctor about ways to keep your bones healthy especially if you are an adult over 50"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
